props.description:
This table lists workcenters and it's attributes
Links out to workcenter source location, work order process distribution and, product setup material

props.label: Multi Out Capable
props.description: If True - this workcenter is capable of producing multiple outputs, if false, only 1 output will ever be produced at a time.

props.label: History Sync
props.description: If History Sync is true - Fuuz will import the workcenter history transaction records from an external system for this workcenter. Do not turn this on, if you have this workcenter integrated to Fuuz.

props.label: Created At
props.description: The date and time the record was created.

props.label: Updated At
props.description: The date and time the record was last updated.

props.label: Auto Production
props.description: Enable Auto Production for the workcenter - will still require user to initiate auto-production from a dashboard - this will produce into Fuuz first automatically based on PLC input. Requires customer specific implimentations.

props.label: Mode Group
props.description: Mode Group linked to this workcenter.

props.label: Production Sync
props.description: Syncronize Production history for this workcenter - Only use, if you are not reporting production through Fuuz directly or via PLC integration. The use here would be if production / scrap entries are being done in an external system, this boolean is used to indicate you want those records pulled from that external system, into Fuuz for analysis.

props.label: Multi Out Capable
props.description: If True - this workcenter is capable of producing multiple outputs, if false, only 1 output will ever be produced at a time.

props.label: Production History Sync
props.description: Syncronize Production history for this workcenter - Only use, if you are not reporting production through Fuuz directly or via PLC integration. The use here would be if production / scrap entries are being done in an external system, this boolean is used to indicate you want those records pulled from that external system, into Fuuz for analysis.

props.label: Run Sync
props.description: When True, runs will be able to be synchronized from a 3rd party system. When set to False, all production runs will be initiated only through Fuuz/ or via your PLC integration with Fuuz. The Synch option will not be available to the end user for a given workcenter when this is False.

props.label: Run Sync
props.description: When True, runs will be able to be synchronized from a 3rd party system. When set to False, all production runs will be initiated only through Fuuz/ or via your PLC integration with Fuuz. The Synch option will not be available to the end user for a given workcenter when this is False.
